question: Ajaz Patel who grabbed 10 wickets in the second Test against India in Mumbai in 2021 is from which country?
solution:
The correct answer is** __New Zealand.__**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ​**Ajaz Yunus Patel** represents **Central Districts **in domestic cricket as a **cricketer** from New Zealand.
 
• In **October 2018,** he made his international cricket **debut** for New Zealand.
 
• Ajaz is incidentally the **fifth cricketer** of **Indian descent** to play for New Zealand.
 
• Patel is a **left-arm **orthodoxy spin bowler who bowls slowly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rules about **international** cricket

 
 
• In a game of **cricket**, two **11-man teams** alternately bat and field the ball to prevent the **opponent **from scoring while the other team bowls and **fields **the ball to stop them.
 
• To **score** as many **runs** as you can against your opponent is the **main goal i**n cricket.
 
• Cricket is a game in which there are two teams, each with eleven players.
 
• Every team will have a turn at **hitting** and** fielding **or bowling for at least **one inning** during each game.
 
• A** bowler** from the fielding team will bowl the ball to the batsman who **attempts t**o hit it with their bat.
 
 
 
• The ICC **Champions Trophy**, which New Zealand won in Kenya in 2000–01, is its **only international championship**.
 
• New Zealand is **well-known** for its **rugby team,** Maori culture, and picturesque scenery.
